title: dev.qory.session.notification
description: The runtime notified its user: it waits for a permission, it is idle, it needs input.

kind.description: The notification type, in the runtime's words: permission_prompt, idle_prompt.

agent_id.description: The subagent this happened in, when it did not happen in the main conversation.

agent_type.description: The subagent's type, or the agent the session was started as.
